cases.name: AI proposes, no confirmed error
cases.expected_behavior: Not listed in teacher-confirmed error totals

cases.name: Teacher confirms a source-bound observation
cases.expected_behavior: Same source revision and attempt anchor; one thread

cases.name: A lucky retry is not proof
cases.expected_behavior: Correct final number alone does not close thread

cases.name: Transfer verified
cases.expected_behavior: Distinct task and evidence of reasoning, human or scoped verifier approval

cases.name: Recurrence after verification
cases.expected_behavior: Previous attempt not overwritten and next remedial action shown

cases.name: Transcription error rejected
cases.expected_behavior: Reason and correction recorded; false-positive excluded

cases.name: Question ambiguous
cases.expected_behavior: Source ambiguity addressed before penalizing student

cases.name: Idempotency
cases.expected_behavior: Same idempotency key does not duplicate observation/thread

cases.name: No AI available
cases.expected_behavior: Manual tutor review continues with zero provider calls

cases.name: Cross-course portability
cases.expected_behavior: Student retains diary in Analisi, other teacher does not inherit access

cases.name: Revoked source
cases.expected_behavior: Current visible diary hides revoked source, marks evidence unavailable, invalidates derived model

cases.name: Cross-student negative
cases.expected_behavior: Student B receives 403/404 and no signed storage URL, no diary disclosure
